data.goal: Begin fresh observation in structured fault/error-code domains by reading actual practitioner rows on Discourse forums to validate the view_count instrument's discrimination before any classifier

data.summary: Reviewed current state: 6 invention claims tested, none validated; view_count principle validated on multiple platforms; 4 structured-fault domains tested (OBD2, embedded, 3D printer, PX4); E088 showed classifier failure; E092 validated simplified instrument on hand-classified labels; ready for fresh observation in new domain

Completed fresh observation in robotics/ROS error codes domain (E097): discrimination test PASS (FPR=0.0, TPR=0.8, FNR=0.2); population measurement shows 55.6% unserved fraction (9 need statements, CI95 [26.7%, 81.1%]) — higher than Discourse baseline 11.7% but sample insufficient for G3; view_count instrument generalizes (100% view_positive_rate); instrument validated for new domain per D083/D095

data.next: Expand practitioner sample to ≥20 rows by harvesting more Discourse categories and pages, then re-measure population with validated instrument. Alternatively, test instrument on medical device alarm codes (E082 protocol) or industrial PLC fault codes (E084 protocol) for cross-domain validation.
data.summary: Fresh observation in robotics/ROS error codes domain (E097): Collected 10 practitioner rows from Open Robotics Discourse forum across Nav2, Gazebo, and Open-RMF categories. Discrimination test PASSED (FPR=0.000, TPR=0.800, FNR=0.200) on 10 probes with labels known by construction. Population measurement: 9 need statements, unserved-open-like fraction 55.6% (Wilson CI95 [26.7%, 81.1%]), higher than Discourse baseline 11.7% (E077) and embedded Discourse 15.3% (E082). View count instrument generalizes (100% view_positive_rate). Sample size insufficient for protocol G3 threshold (need ≥15). No candidate produced; evidence-gathering per D083.
